name: claude-Reconstruction
headline: claude engineering docs and skills organization
short_description: Provide Claude with complete and effective engineering documentation, organize skills/plugins/error question banks/MCP skill collections, handle full Claude engineering adaptation capabilities, and expand decision trees, library knowledge bases, and other functionalities.
author: Arxchibobo

sections.overview:
Claude Reconstruction is a 5-layer engineering configuration system designed to make Claude Code behave like a senior engineer rather than a chatbot. It intelligently loads only relevant documentation per task type, reducing context window consumption from 60% to approximately 20%, while enforcing a structured workflow of planning, confirmation, execution, and delivery. The system includes 8 specialist agents (Planner, Architect, Code Reviewer, Security Analyst, and others), a 15-pattern error library, and persistent memory that survives conversation resets. It automates 95% of decisions autonomously—only asking for user input in 4 specific cases: missing credentials, mutually exclusive approaches, contradictory requirements, or irreversible high-risk operations. Developers benefit from reduced cognitive overhead, faster autonomous execution, and patterns that improve across sessions without manual reporting.
Reduce Claude Code context consumption for complex multi-file projects
Automate full engineering workflows without constant user confirmations
Enforce consistent coding standards and security rules across sessions
Route complex architectural or security decisions to specialist agents

